messages:
rachel: Hi all — quick onboarding snag. Installed ruby via asdf (3.2.2) on M2. bundle install fails when compiling native gem nokogiri with errors about libxml2/openssl. Any mac/apple-silicon tips?

tom: Welcome! Common issue. macOS needs brew libs available at build time. Try `brew install libxml2 libxslt openssl@1.1` then set envs before building gems.

rachel: what envs exactly and where do I put them so VS Code terminal also sees them?

tom: Short snippet I keep in ~/.zprofile:
```bash
export PATH="/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH"
export LDFLAGS="-L/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@1.1/lib -L/opt/homebrew/opt/libxml2/lib"
export CPPFLAGS="-I/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@1.1/include -I/opt/homebrew/opt/libxml2/include"
export PKG_CONFIG_PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/libxml2/lib/pkgconfig"
. $HOME/.asdf/asdf.sh
```
Then reopen terminal, `gem pristine nokogiri -- --use-system-libraries` or `bundle config build.nokogiri --use-system-libraries` and `bundle install`.

evan: FYI if VS Code launched from the Dock doesn't pick up ~/.zprofile envs, you can export them for GUI apps too using launchctl so Code inherits them: e.g. `launchctl setenv REPO_TOKEN "..."` or for PATH-related stuff run `launchctl setenv PATH /opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH`. Restart VS Code after that. It's a bit heavy-handed so we usually only set tokens/flags that need GUI apps.

rachel: nice — I used `bundle config` then `bundle install` and nokogiri built. One follow-up: dotfiles question — starter dotfiles has a `secrets.example.env` that stow links into ~/.config. Should I keep REPO_TOKEN in that env file or use keychain?

tom: Don't commit secrets. Use macOS Keychain + direnv: store token in Keychain and in your local `.envrc` pull it via `export REPO_TOKEN=$(security find-generic-password -s redwood-repo -w)`. Keep `.envrc` out of git.

intra-bot: Reminder: New-hire office hours tomorrow 11:00am PT for live help with M1/M2 build issues and dotfiles. :calendar:

rachel: thanks everyone — ruby/gems green now. I'll add a tiny note to the dotfiles PR about the nokogiri system libs trick.
